pr.title: Say that /reload-plugins loads an upgraded plugin
pr.head: 72b8c35197c129efd183dde5e2f7482baacdb3a5

summary: Projector's installer, install.sh, installs or updates the Projector plugin and its gh-stack dependency in Claude Code. project upgrade runs the same installer. When Claude Code updates a plugin, the only advice it prints is "Restart to apply changes." A session that is already open does not need a restart, though. Running /reload-plugins in it loads the new version in place.

This change makes the installer end its Claude Code section with a reload row that says so. The row prints only when the run changed the installed version of Projector or gh-stack, a first install included. A run that changes nothing prints no row, and the Codex section is untouched. docs/plugins.md describes the row and names /reload-plugins beside a restart.

cards.title: Review so far
cards.html:
• One Projector review of 72b8c35: clean, with no finding threads.
  • A live run against the real claude 2.1.314 in a scratch config printed the row on an upgrade from 0.8.4, and no row on the run after it.

groups.title: The installer prints a reload row
groups.kicker: install.sh compares the plugin versions before and after a Claude Code install
intro: install_claude is the installer function that adds or refreshes Projector's marketplace in Claude Code, then installs or updates projector@projector and gh-stack@projector. It now records both installed versions before it starts and again at the end. When the two readings differ, it prints the reload row in the installer's usual two-column form.
The versions come from host_plugin_version, which reads claude plugin list --json. Each reading costs one more claude call, about half a second, during a run that also downloads and installs plugins.

files.note: Reads the versions before the marketplace step and compares them after the gh-stack step.

checks.text: This comparison cannot fail the install. host_plugin_version ends in || true, so claude_plugin_versions always succeeds, and the [ … ] || printf list succeeds on both branches under set -euo pipefail. A live run in a scratch HOME and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR exited 0 on both an upgrade and a run that changed nothing.
One string holds both versions. A change to either plugin, or a plugin going from absent to installed, makes the before and after strings differ.

files.note: The fake claude now swaps in a second plugin list after an update or install, so a test can simulate a version change.

checks.text: Against main's install.sh, all three cases of test_a_changed_plugin_says_an_open_session_can_reload_it fail. Both new tests pass at this head.

groups.title: The documentation names /reload-plugins
groups.kicker: docs/plugins.md describes the row and the reload
intro: The plugin guide gains a paragraph on the reload row. Its section on updating an installed copy now says an open Claude Code session applies an update when you run /reload-plugins or restart it.

files.note: One new paragraph after the gh-stack install notes, and one revised sentence in the update section.

checks.text: Claude Code 2.1.314 itself tells you to run /reload-plugins to apply a plugin that its autoupdate changed, which supports this paragraph. project upgrade passes the installer's output through and prints no restart advice of its own.
